name: load-transient
description: Load-transient step response (primary, ratified) plus a supplementary line-transient step, one tran deck
claim: README.md Target specification, 'Load transient' row (DR-0004 amendment A4): 1<->50 mA step, 1us edges, C_eff=0.33uF (DR-0001's hardest stability-window corner) + 0-500 mOhm ESR: peak excursion <=150 mV (100 mV stretch), recovery to within +/-1% (18 mV) in <=20 us. This deck reports peak excursion (both directions); a precise .meas-based recovery-time number is intentionally NOT emitted here -- the placeholder error amp the committed records were taken against (issue #9, since landed by PR #35, which replaced the placeholder) is a near-ideal, effectively infinite-bandwidth behavioral source, so the observed excursion never leaves the +/-1% band and an ngspice '.meas WHEN' crossing search has no crossing to find (fails hard rather than reporting a trivial 0), which would make every corner ERROR for a measurement-plumbing reason rather than a real spec finding. Deferred to a future record once #9/#10 land a bandwidth-limited amp with a real settling transient to measure. The deck also runs a supplementary Vin step (+/-10% around this PVT point's own vdd_val) after the load step settles, exercising dynamic line response -- this is NOT a distinct ratified spec row (the ratified 'Line reg' row is DC-only, see sim/line-regulation/); reported for completeness per the original issue #12 body's 'load-transient and line-transient response' wording, and excluded from this record's pass/fail checks so it cannot be mistaken for a ratified verdict.
analyses: meas tran vmin_load MIN v(vout) FROM=51u TO=71u
meas tran vmax_load MAX v(vout) FROM=151u TO=171u
meas tran vmin_line MIN v(vout) FROM=202u TO=222u
meas tran vmax_line MAX v(vout) FROM=302u TO=322u

operating_conditions.load_current: 1 mA <-> 50 mA step at t=50us (1us edges); held between 51-150us then reverted
operating_conditions.output_cap: 0.33 uF (DR-0001 stability-window floor, the hardest corner for this row) + 100 mOhm ESR
operating_conditions.enable_state: enabled (EN tied to VIN at instantiation)
operating_conditions.supplementary_line_step: Vin steps to 0.9x/1.1x this PVT point's own vdd_val at t=200us/300us (Iload held at 1mA) -- NOT a ratified spec row, see Claim
